updates.note: Management reiterated the 19% to 21% EBITDA margin range target for the coming year.
updates.quote: We're still confident that we will operate between 19% to 21%... for the coming year as well.

updates.note: Management stated marketing spend target of close to 5% for the next year, confirming previous guidance range.
updates.quote: We target to take that up to close to 5% in the next year.
